title: AccreditationAlertRaisedPayload
description: Payload of the AccreditationAlertRaised platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-1365, INV-AC-2340, INV-Q-7316, INV-Q-7336 option A). control-plane-svc emits it once per alertRef when it opens an accreditation task. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

alertRef.description: The alert; one event is emitted per alertRef.

taskRef.description: The tracked accreditation task opened for the release train.

releaseRef.description: The release train concerned, when there is one.

currentUntil.description: The date until which the current accreditation holds, when known.
